name: Social Engineering Heist
rootCause: A high net worth individual's hardware wallet was compromised on January 10, 2026, after being deceived into divulging their recovery seed to a scammer posing as Trezor support. The attacker immediately drained 1,459 BTC and 2.05 million LTC (worth $282 million), swiftly moving and laundering the funds via instant exchanges, cross-chain bridges, and privacy assets such as Monero. Only a minor fraction was reportedly frozen before reaching privacy destinations.
